description: This file defines a Kotlin class `DeviceNotificationListenerService` that extends Android's `NotificationListenerService`. It manages notification events such as posting and removal, maintains a store of current notifications, interacts with user preferences, and handles notification actions like opening, dismissing, and replying. Additionally, it includes helper functions and classes for managing notification data and event emissions within an Android application.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a notification, including properties like key, package name, title, text, category, timing, and flags for ongoing and clearable status.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
classes.description: Data class capturing the snapshot of notifications state, including whether notifications are enabled, connection status, and the list of current notifications.

classes.name: NotificationActionRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to perform an action on a notification, such as opening, dismissing, or replying.

classes.name: NotificationActionResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the result of a notification action, indicating success and optional messages or codes.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService
classes.description: Main service class extending Android's NotificationListenerService, handling notification events, maintaining internal store, and executing notification actions.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Sanitizes and trims notification text to a maximum length, returning null if empty.

methods.name: toJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a DeviceNotificationEntry into a JSON object.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current notifications state.

methods.name: serviceComponent
methods.description: Constructs the ComponentName for this service.

methods.name: setNodeEventSink
methods.description: Assigns a callback for emitting notification change events.

methods.name: recentPackages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recently notified package names.

methods.name: isAccessEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification access is granted.

methods.name: requestServiceRebind
methods.description: Requests the system to rebind the notification listener service.

methods.name: executeAction
methods.description: Performs an action (open, dismiss, reply) on a specified notification request.

methods.name: executeActionInternal
methods.description: Internal method executing the specific notification action based on the request.

methods.name: refreshActiveNotifications
methods.description: Refreshes the internal store of notifications from active notifications.

methods.name: toEntry
methods.description: Converts a StatusBarNotification to a DeviceNotificationEntry.
